svg.title: Dock. Undock. Keep moving.
svg.desc: A MacBook with a desk monitor stays linked to a Windows PC. When the desk monitor is unplugged, the crossing moves to the built-in display. Reconnecting the monitor restores its crossing. Control returns to the local computer when displays change, releasing remote keys. The actual v2.4.2 display summary updates from two displays to one and back. Native desktop imagery and sample monitor changes illustrate the behavior, not hardware detection speed.
svg.text: Your other computers stay within reach as your screens change.

g.text: Docked: cross from the desk monitor.
The crossing uses the monitor you arranged.
The crossing moves to a screen that is still there.
Plug the monitor back in. Your arrangement is remembered.

svg.text: When displays change, control comes back here. No key stays held on the other computer.
INPUT SHARING · ORIGINAL V2.4.2 DISPLAY SUMMARY
No restart or reconnect. Update both computers for the full behavior.
Native desktop imagery and original app captures. Crossings and timing are illustrated.
